reply_text:
I couldn't confirm the 23 May deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form. There are no Thornbury files in the shared folders and no mention of them in #central-team, so I had nothing to check the date against.

The date also looks off. Today is 14 October, so 23 May has either already passed or means next May. I suggested you ask your Thornbury contact which year they mean and to confirm it in writing.

I replied in the thread under your message in #central-team. I also saved a note in this channel marking the date as unconfirmed, so no one treats it as a firm deadline. I offered to set a reminder or draft a follow-up email to your contact. Because that contact is outside pemberline.com, Ruth Calloway would have to approve the email first.
